scenario: bool_and / bool_or are NOT admitted under the `sample` time model (LSER.16.8.3). They are exact predicates, not statistical summaries: a uniform reservoir can omit the one value that determines the AND/OR, so the reduction over the sample is not faithful (unlike mean/pXX, which are unbiased estimators). The SeriesBackendReservoir runtime backing can compute bool over the bag (registry.c SBRS_AGGS), but the compiler — the language contract — rejects it. Pin: `bool_and sample 200` rejects with DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_AGG_TIME_MODEL_MISMATCH.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    active: Bool mutable

series Sensor.active:
    bool_and sample 200
